units.source_text: 她那合上的浓密睫毛，看起来好像是半睁着的黑眸子。

en.t: Her thick, closed eyelashes looked like black eyes half open.

units.source_text: 翌日凌晨，岛村醒来，驹子已经一只胳膊搭在火盆上，在一本旧杂志背后乱涂乱画开了。

en.t: Early the next morning, when Shimamura woke, Komako already had one arm resting on the brazier and was scribbling on the back of an old magazine.
